turns.assessment: The simultaneous interruption of every service transiting S08, across many endpoint pairs and directions, localizes the failure to the common transit function at S08. Services terminating at S08 remain operational, while optical power, OSNR, BER, DGD, and amplifier telemetry show no change, strongly excluding line-system and ROADM optical faults. This is the characteristic footprint of the S08 OTN switch fabric failing.

proposals.rationale: E1 (otn.S08) is common to all affected working paths. A switch-fabric failure interrupts every ODU cross-connected through it, explaining the simultaneous widespread outage and protection switching, while services terminating at S08 and optical telemetry remain normal.

The S08 ROADM is also common, but a documented WSS input-port failure would affect only channels arriving on one degree and should create optical signal-loss indications. The outage spans many degrees and directions with unchanged optical measurements.
